//: WMS GetFeatureInfo sobre una zona: los atributos reales de los postes.
//ojo: Solo nombres de capa, conteos, claves y tipos. Ningun valor de atributo.

steps.eval: const findNode = (rx) => [...document.querySelectorAll('.x-tree-node-text')].find((el) => rx.test(el.textContent.trim())); const apps = findNode(/^aplicaciones$/i); if (apps) { let c = apps; for (let i = 0; i < 6 && c; i += 1) { if (c.querySelector && c.querySelector('.x-tree-expander')) break; c = c.parentElement; } const ex = c ? c.querySelector('.x-tree-expander') : null; (ex || apps).click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000)); } const mapa = findNode(/^mapas?$/i); if (!mapa) return { error: 'no Mapas' }; mapa.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10000)); return { ready: true };

const w = document.querySelector('#content').contentWindow; const ol = w.ol; const map = w.webMap_.scaleLineControl.map_; const req = (params, ms) => new Promise((resolve) => { let done = false; const finish = (v) => { if (!done) { done = true; resolve(v); } }; const timer = setTimeout(() => finish({ ok: false, e: 'timeout' }), ms || 12000); const fail = (e) => { clearTimeout(timer); finish({ ok: false, e: String((e && e.message) || e) }); }; try { w.Acs.request({ url: 'svc_wmc.php', params, success: (r) => { clearTimeout(timer); finish({ ok: true, r }); }, failure: fail }); } catch (err) { fail(err); } }); const vp = w.webMap_.getViewportParams ? w.webMap_.getViewportParams() : {}; const out = {}; const s = await req(Object.assign({ action: 'textual_search', query: 'F913184', page: 1, start: 0, limit: 25 }, vp)); const rows = (s.ok && (Array.isArray(s.r) ? s.r : (s.r.rows || s.r.data))) || []; const ids = rows.map((x) => x.object_id).filter(Boolean); const gj = await req(Object.assign({ action: 'get_objects_geojson', object_ids: w.Ext.encode(ids) }, vp)); const norm = (r) => (r && r.type === 'Feature' ? [r] : (r && r.features) || []); const feats = norm(gj.r); if (!feats.length) return { error: 'sin punto base' }; const lon = feats[0].geometry.coordinates[0]; const lat = feats[0].geometry.coordinates[1]; const view = map.getView(); view.setCenter(ol.proj.fromLonLat([lon, lat])); view.setZoom(17); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3500)); const size = map.getSize(); const bbox = view.calculateExtent(size); out.zoom = view.getZoom(); out.size = size; const layers = map.getLayers().getArray(); const targets = []; for (const l of layers) { let src = null; try { src = l.getSource ? l.getSource() : null; } catch (e) {} if (!src || typeof src.getParams !== 'function') continue; let p = null; try { p = src.getParams(); } catch (e) { continue; } if (!p || !p.LAYERS) continue; targets.push({ name: String(p.LAYERS).slice(0, 120), version: p.VERSION || null, format: p.FORMAT || null, visible: l.getVisible() }); } out.layersWithParams = targets.length; out.targets = targets.slice(0, 12); const askOne = async (name, fmt) => { const q = new URLSearchParams({ SERVICE: 'WMS', VERSION: '1.1.1', REQUEST: 'GetFeatureInfo', LAYERS: name, QUERY_LAYERS: name, STYLES: '', SRS: 'EPSG:3857', CRS: 'EPSG:3857', BBOX: bbox.join(','), WIDTH: String(Math.round(size[0])), HEIGHT: String(Math.round(size[1])), X: String(Math.round(size[0] / 2)), Y: String(Math.round(size[1] / 2)), I: String(Math.round(size[0] / 2)), J: String(Math.round(size[1] / 2)), FEATURE_COUNT: '200', INFO_FORMAT: fmt }); const c = new AbortController(); const t = setTimeout(() => c.abort(), 12000); try { const r = await w.fetch('/webmap/saesa/service?' + q.toString(), { credentials: 'same-origin', signal: c.signal }); const text = await r.text(); const res = { status: r.status, ct: (r.headers.get('content-type') || '').slice(0, 40), bytes: text.length }; try { const j = JSON.parse(text); res.json = true; res.features = (j.features || []).length; res.propKeys = [...new Set((j.features || []).flatMap((f) => Object.keys(f.properties || {})))].slice(0, 30); res.geomTypes = [...new Set((j.features || []).map((f) => f.geometry && f.geometry.type))]; } catch (e) { res.json = false; res.head = text.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 200); } return res; } catch (e) { return { error: String(e.message).slice(0, 80) }; } finally { clearTimeout(t); } }; out.probes = []; for (const tgt of targets.slice(0, 6)) { out.probes.push({ layer: tgt.name.slice(0, 60), visible: tgt.visible, json: await askOne(tgt.name, 'application/json'), html: null }); } return out;
